'''Gudrun Kadereit''' (born 1969)<ref>{{Cite web|date=2021|title=Gudrun Kadereit|url=http://sweetgum.nybg.org/science/ih/person-details/?irn=160998|access-date=2021-09-22|website=sweetgum.nybg.org|publisher=William & Lynda Steere Herbarium, NYBG}}</ref> is a German [[botanist]], the Princess Therese von Bayern Chair of Systematics, Biodiversity and Evolution of Plants at [[LMU Munich]] and the director of both the [[Botanical Garden Munich-Nymphenburg]] and the Botanical State Collection Munich.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Brünner|first=Mira|date=March 14, 2021|title=Die "Juwelen" kennenlernen|url=https://www.sueddeutsche.de/muenchen/meine-woche-die-juwelen-kennenlernen-1.5234982|access-date=2021-09-22|website=Süddeutsche.de|publisher=Süddeutsche Zeitung|language=de}}</ref><ref name="quinoa">{{Cite web|last=Scherf|first=Martina|date=May 28, 2021|title=Die Kraft der Quinoa|url=https://www.sueddeutsche.de/muenchen/wundersame-welt-der-pflanzen-die-kraft-der-quinoa-1.5307116|access-date=2021-09-22|website=Süddeutsche.de|publisher=Süddeutsche Zeitung|language=de}}</ref>

Her research focuses on [[angiosperm]] [[phylogenetics]], [[systematics]] and [[biogeography]], in particular on the families [[Amaranthaceae]], [[Melastomataceae]], [[Crassulaceae]], [[Aizoaceae]] and [[Zygophyllaceae]] but also on the [[evolution]] of C4 photosynthesis and [[Crassulacean_acid_metabolism|Crassulacean Acid Metabolism]] (CAM) and the evolution of seed traits.<br>
